name: onehome-mcp
description: OneHome (CoreLogic) real-estate access for Claude — search listings, fetch property details, photos, schools, and run mortgage / affordability math against your agent-shared OneHome portal

onehome_magic_link.title: OneHome magic link
onehome_magic_link.description: The full portal.onehome.com URL your agent emailed you (it contains ?token=...). Optional: if neither this nor the token is set, the server captures the bearer from a signed-in portal.onehome.com tab via the browser bridge.

onehome_token.title: OneHome bearer token
onehome_token.description: A raw OneHome bearer (session JWT) copied from the portal's network requests. Optional, and takes precedence over the magic link when both are set.

onehome_ws_port.title: fetchproxy port (advanced)
onehome_ws_port.description: Override the fetchproxy WebSocket port (default 37149). Only used when ONEHOME_TOKEN / ONEHOME_MAGIC_LINK are unset and the MCP boots in capture-from-tab mode.

onehome_communities_file.title: Community vocabulary file (advanced)
onehome_communities_file.description: Path to a JSON array of community names used for feature extraction; overrides the built-in Lake Lure / mountain-NC default vocabulary.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: fetchproxy bind address (advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: fetchproxy identity directory (advanced)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
